name: Video Game College: FPS Edition
source:
Have you ever wanted to date a video game genre?
Well, now you can! Introducing Video Game College (VGC) FPS edition.

In this game, the player embarks on a journey to fix Devon, the personification of the FPS genre, and fall in love!

[From [url=https://soeyzandiego.itch.io/vgc-fps-edition]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾想过，与一种电子游戏类型约会？
现在，你可以了！隆重介绍《Video Game College》的FPS篇。

在这款游戏中，玩家将踏上帮助FPS类型化身——德文——改变自己的旅程，并坠入爱河！

[摘自[url=https://soeyzandiego.itch.io/vgc-fps-edition]itch.io[/url]]
